distance: Exact unit-cost insertion/deletion/substitution Levenshtein via dynamic programming. similarity=1-distance/max(len(left),len(right)); empty sides UNKNOWN, not perfect agreement.

Unicode.all_kinds: NFC; CRLF/CR -> LF. Never global NFKC.
Unicode.code_and_description: Retain all remaining codepoints and all whitespace including indentation and quoted string spaces; do not strip comments, quotes, punctuation or string literals.
Unicode.formula: Only Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols U+1D400..U+1D7FF with Unicode name prefix MATHEMATICAL are font-folded to base characters. Explicit native typography ligatures ﬀ/ﬁ/ﬂ/ﬃ/ﬄ/ﬅ/ﬆ -> ff/fi/fl/ffi/ffl/st/st. Remove whitespace only for character-distance string, never token inventories. All other symbols retained, including − vs -, × vs *, Greek variants, accents, superscript Unicode and fences.

visible_formula_projection.TeX: Use pinned latex2mathml3.81.1 to PresentationMathML; unsupported commands surviving as backslash in visible tokens, merror or unsupported structural nodes => UNKNOWN. No author-macro guessing and no raw TeX-control-command-length comparison.
visible_formula_projection.MathML: Read visible token text in declared tree sequence; ignore annotations/phantoms; fraction numerator then denominator separated by line boundary; table row-major with spaces/newlines; msqrt prefixes √; mroot index then √ then radicand. mfenced explicit fences/separator. Script/accent tokens are linearized, not reconstructed 2D grouping.
visible_formula_projection.native: Use explicitly source-aligned native visible glyph/character sequence; same NFC and kind-specific normalization. Do not infer missing fraction bars/2D braces from semantic source.
visible_formula_projection.limitation: Character/op/number agreement cannot establish fraction scope, superscript attachment, matrices/cases or other 2D grouping; agreement may falsely support semantically wrong reconstructions.

operator_sequence: Exact ordered subsequence of preregistered visible symbol set in character_helpers.OPERATORS, before font/ligature or whitespace normalization. Includes quoted-code symbols. No aliases for −/- or ×/*. Alphabetic named operators not semantically interpreted. No invented fraction slash.
number_sequence: Ordered ASCII decimal/scientific lexical runs from original NFC visible text before style/whitespace changes; includes indices and quoted strings. Signs checked independently as operators; no numeric rounding or merging whitespace-separated digits. Regex frozen in helper. Unicode non-ASCII digits remain literal for character comparison and are not silently numerically interpreted.
primary_a_b: Known and character>=.95 AND ordered operators exact AND ordered numbers exact. b additionally requires source-derived same-region identity. Missing feature/provenance => UNKNOWN/NO_DECISION, not negative semantic truth.
b_identity: PDF SHA equal + original page equal + matching frozen source_equation_identity OR frozen_native_ref_identity OR crop_identity. Never reconstruction-text similarity for pairing. Multi-page block correspondence unresolved => UNKNOWN; do not attach its block label to lines.
c: Pinned latex2mathml -> sanitized static local MathML with actual isolated Chrome155 render. Unsupported/unresolved TeX/MathML UNKNOWN. Require MathMLCore CSS support, nonempty per-unit bbox, no merror and screenshot exists. Rendering is not semantic proof. Batch local file only; no raw paper scripts/CDN; CSP default-src none; resolver MAP * ~NOTFOUND; background networking/component update/sync/extensions disabled; profile/cache/crashdump only W3b/tmp.
unit_and_labels: W3 original50 whole source blocks retain their original labels; primary excludes7 metadata items. Code21 source units exclude4 alignment errors. No block labels copied to fake line labels. Unknown-label signal-pass separate.
metrics: Frozen signals-preregistration/operationalization remain authoritative. Exact primary confusion matrix on known/evaluable labels; unavailable NO_DECISION separately; error-positive and pass-as-correct precision/recall both; verified wrong and coverage, exact binomial CI; continuous/binary ROC descriptive, no threshold change.
